title: AgentCredential
description: Claims of an SD-JWT VC (vct in.bacp.agent.1) issued by a registry-accredited issuer to an agent operated by a registered legal entity and bound to a BAP subscriber.

iss.description: Issuer: ONDC registry / DeDi record or accredited issuer

sub.description: Agent id, e.g. did:web:agents.example.in:krishi-voice or urn:bacp:agent:...

build.description: Release or build hash of the agent runtime

uap_agent_id.description: Reserved for an NPCI UAP registry id once published

cnf.description: RFC 7800 key binding. The same key signs RFC 9421 requests and KB-JWTs that close open mandates.

purposes.description: RFC 9421 signature tags this key may use (Visa TAP-style browse/pay split). bacp-negotiate covers firm offers, ACCEPT, bids and RFQ awards.

human_handoff_url.description: Web page that leads to a human. Kept for compatibility; typed routes are in handoff_routes.

handoff_routes.description: Typed routes to a human. MUST contain a tel: route (with or without DTMF digits) when agent.channels includes voice, ivr or upi123pay. A route stays usable after the principal's mandate is revoked.

compensation_model.description: How the agent operator is paid: not at all, by sellers, by the principal, or by both. OPTIONAL. When present, the operator_compensation of every mandate request signed with this credential MUST be consistent with it.

data_residency.description: Optional data-residency statement (fail-safe default until Q-15 is settled). A gateway MUST NOT treat a missing or incomplete data_residency statement as permission to send payment data outside India; a gateway, Mandate Manager or PSP adapter stores and processes payment data only in India.

payment_data.description: Where payment data is stored and processed. Always IN (RBI Storage of Payment System Data, RBI/2017-18/153, 06-04-2018).

llm_region.description: Region in which the agent operator's language model processes data it receives, e.g. IN.

log_region.description: Region in which the agent operator's logs are stored, e.g. IN.

transfer_basis.description: Legal basis for any cross-border transfer of other personal data (DPDP Act s.16 and Rule 15, from 13-05-2027). Never a basis for sending payment data abroad.

conformance.description: The conformance levels the agent's stack has passed, with the signed attestation issued after a conformance run.

levels.description: Ids of the conformance levels passed: bacp.core.1 (Core), bacp.pay.upi.1 (Payments-UPI), bacp.pay.all.1 (Payments-All), bacp.neg.1 (Negotiation), bacp.b2b.1 (B2B), bacp.auction.1 (Auctions), bacp.ts.1 (Trusted Surface).

attestation.description: Signed conformance attestation (conformance credential) listing the same levels.
